name: Wallacei
components: Evolutionary multi-objective optimisation engine. Open its window (double-click) and press Start.
Decodes Wallacei genomes and outputs gene (slider) values per solution
Decodes Wallacei phenotypes into geometry, meshes, numbers and text
Distributes exported phenotypes and their data onto a grid in the Rhino scene
Compares each fitness criterion to the others in a parallel coordinate plot, per solution
Analyses data from the Parallel Coordinate Plot component
Displays the diamond fitness chart and fitness ranking per solution
Displays the objective space of the solutions' fitness values
Plots SD factor per generation and a trendline
Calculates and plots the Pareto Front for a selected generation
Plots mean values per generation and a trendline
Plots fitness values per individual per generation
Calculates SD and draws the normal distribution graph per generation
Extracts the fitness values from an Octopus fitness value export file
Orders the Fitness Value list from WallaceiX for the Wallacei Analytics components
Shuffles gene pools and number sliders renamed with the wlc_ prefix
